podcast.title: Mellow Rock Trend (Early 1970s)
podcast.body: Bread was cited as an example of artists popular in the early 1970s whose music contributed to the "Mellow" trend, as fans deserted the harder, more soulful sounds of the 60s for a softer approach. "The word everyone was using was Mellow, James Taylor, Bread, Olivia Newton John, Paul Simon, the California Rock of the Eagles, a new look Fleetwood Mac."

xref.title: Sam's Town Tour Rider (2006) – Standard Provisions
xref.body: The rider for the "Sam's Town" tour included fairly standard requests such as chocolate bars (Snickers, Kit Kat), a deli tray sufficient for 20 people with sliced cheese, crackers, white bread, and fresh fruits and vegetables, including six fresh avocados. "a selection of chocolate bars, Snickers, Kit Kat and so on a deli tray enough to feed 20 people with a commensurate amount of sliced cheese, crackers, and white bread, also some fruits and veggies, and six fresh avocados."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Backstage Rider – Strict Dietary Restrictions
xref.body: Weezer's rider emphasized vegetarian and organic food only, suggesting soup or vegetarian chili as good options. They specifically requested a particular type of sprouted whole grain bread and explicitly warned against providing blueberry or black raspberry jam, stating a preference for strawberry. "It's just best to stick with strawberry for Weiser."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Bread as Merchandise
xref.body: Alice Cooper ventured into unusual merchandise in 2020, offering his own branded bread. "Alice Cooper bread, chocolate milk."
